title: The Deligne--Mumford locus in the stack of proper curves
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field]. Let $\mathfrak C$ be the algebraic stack whose objects over a $k$-scheme $T$ are flat proper finitely presented morphisms $X\to T$ of algebraic spaces with geometric fibres of dimension at most one. There is a maximal open substack $\mathfrak C^{\mathrm{DM}}\subset\mathfrak C$ with unramified diagonal, and it is a Deligne--Mumford stack in the scheme-atlas convention of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For any algebraically closed extension field $\Omega/k$ and proper $\Omega$-scheme $C$ of dimension at most one, the point represented by $C$ belongs to this open if and only if every automorphism of $C\times_\Omega\operatorname{Spec}(\Omega[\epsilon]/(\epsilon^2))$ over the dual numbers that restricts to the identity on $C$ is itself the identity. Every open substack of $\mathfrak C$ all of whose geometric points satisfy this condition is contained in $\mathfrak C^{\mathrm{DM}}$ and is Deligne--Mumford. The dual numbers are [def-sc-dual-numbers]; unramified is [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. Schemes and algebraic spaces use [def-pc-scheme, def-trf-algebraic-space]; flatness, properness, finite presentation, geometric fibres, and dimension use [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-geometric-fibre, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], with the usual algebraic-space extensions: proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed, and finite presentation means quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally of finite presentation; local properties are tested on etale scheme charts. An algebraic stack means a stack in groupoids with representable diagonal and a smooth surjective scheme atlas [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For a representable morphism, unramified means unramified on etale scheme charts after every scheme base change. Open substacks are full substacks whose pullbacks by schemes are open subschemes. Algebraically closed fields use [def-weil-algebraic-closure].

proof.text: For any geometric algebraic-space curve X, the stabilizer comparison supplies x,G,Z,p and identifies membership of X with factorization of x. Apply the field-point stabilizer criterion to the maximal open U. Compose with the comparison of chartwise unramifiedness and the group-scheme identity dual-number test. This gives membership of X in U iff X has trivial infinitesimal automorphisms.

proof.text: A proper scheme curve is realized by a ProperCurveFamily and a presheaf isomorphism over the field. Triviality of infinitesimal automorphisms is invariant under this isomorphism: use pullback.map to identify its dual-number fibre products and conjugate automorphisms; the canonical reduction and the second projection commute with that comparison. In each direction, combine this invariance with the geometric-object criterion of the preceding step and the definition of SchemePointIn.

proof.text: For V satisfying the given infinitesimal condition, the geometric-object criterion puts every geometric object of V in U. The geometric containment theorem gives V contained in U. Full-open restriction retains the unramified diagonal. V is algebraic by the open algebraicity theorem, so the same unramified-diagonal/etale-atlas equivalence makes V Deligne--Mumford.

reviewed.note:
mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N5-1f0020c2f (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read all six steps and the five new nodes in full against the Stacks sources: 0DSW and its proof, 0E6G first paragraph, 0DSQ, 0DSM, 0DSN(1), 06N3, 050N(1), 047I, 0B8F and 02G5. The item is not in the dropped list, has no repair note, and is still unsplit in side-live. Its statement change only adds conventions and is not a weakening.

The new nodes are true and are not duplicates:
- open-dm-locus and unramified-diagonal-etale-atlas are the generic 0DSM and 06N3 lemmas with the relative base (by 050N), not the curve clause.
- dm-point-stabilizer is 0DSN(1).
- proper-curve-automorphism-scheme follows from 0DSQ and 0B8F. It differs from projective-curve-isom-graphs, which needs a projective family over a locally noetherian base.
- group-identity-dual-unramified follows from 047I: Ω=0 iff m_e/m_e²=0 iff T_e=0. Tested on μ_p, α_p, PGL_2, constant finite groups and an imperfect K.

Step checks: step 3 gets the dual-number identification from the naturality of the representing bijection for i and p. Step 4 identifies G_x with Aut(C_T). Steps 5 and 6 (open-substack scheme test and restricted atlas) are genuinely elementary.

One fault (C1/E1): steps 1, 2 and 4 apply theorems whose hypothesis is that 𝔠 is an algebraic stack, and nothing supplied this. The existing same-unit sibling lem-sfb-nodal-curve-stack-smooth states it for exactly this 𝔠. FIX: step 1 now cites that node and proof_deps is updated. There is no cycle, and the node adds no batch-5 reach beyond def-trf-nodal-geometric-fibres, which is a definition.

Batch 5: I accept all six flagged citations. def-trf-algebraic-space is a general definition. def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids is a definition whose closure reaches only the def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism convention, and it was previously accepted. Neither is a step of the trace formula or of Poincaré duality. No SGA source is used and no tool_uses are needed.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer

lean.statement: theorem exists_curveStack_infinitesimal_dm_locus (k : Type u) [Field k] : ∃ U : OpenModuliSubstack (ProperCurveModuli.category (Spec (.of k))), HasUnramifiedModuliDiagonal U.category ∧ IsDeligneMumfordModuliStack U.category ∧ (∀ V : OpenModuliSubstack (ProperCurveModuli.category (Spec (.of k))), HasUnramifiedModuliDiagonal V.category → V.IsContainedIn U) ∧ (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)), IsProper f → topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 1 → (ProperCurveModuli.SchemePointIn U Ω a C f ↔ ProperCurveFamily.HasTrivialInfinitesimalAutomorphisms Ω a (yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (f ≫ a)) (V := Over.mk a) f rfl)))) ∧ (∀ V : OpenModuliSubstack (ProperCurveModuli.category (Spec (.of k))), (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (X : ProperCurveFamily (Over.mk a)), V.property ⟨Over.mk a, X⟩ → ProperCurveFamily.HasTrivialInfinitesimalAutomorphisms Ω a X.projection) → V.IsContainedIn U ∧ IsDeligneMumfordModuliStack V.category)
